title: What 3D Stacked Integrated Circuits Is
provenance: Public research knowledge: documented developments, published research, and established technical references. Real, fact-checked records.
description: 3D stacked integrated circuits build chips upward: multiple silicon layers bonded with nanoscale vias, so logic, memory, and sensors stack vertically instead of spreading flat. It is how density keeps climbing when transistors stop shrinking. This record is the entry point of the teaching ladder for 3D Stacked Integrated Circuits: start here, then move through the research state, the specifications, the public developments, the open challenges, and finally each piece needed to build it.
key_points: 3D Stacked Integrated Circuits in one line: 3D stacked integrated circuits build chips upward: multiple silicon layers bonded with nanoscale vias, so logic, memory, and sensors stack vertically instead of spreading flat.
Why it matters: Stacking shortens wires by 1000x — faster, denser, and more efficient than any flat chip..
Where it is used: AI accelerators, memory stacks (HBM), image sensors, mobile SoCs, chiplets..
Ladder rank 1 — the foundation. Everything else builds on this.
